item.title: European levy on non-EU parcels kicks in on Sunday in bid to curb China influx
item.description: The European Union will from Sunday slap a €2 (US$2.25) handling fee on packages from outside the 27-nation bloc in a bid to curb the influx from China. The new levy – coming just weeks before the Black Friday, Cyber Monday and Christmas season shopping rushes – will be on top of the EU’s €3 fee on small parcels. The fee will apply to each type of item in a package sent directly to consumers from outside the EU regardless of the parcel’s value. For example, if there are 10 T-shirts in a package,... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: Samoa island sees sea turtles return after invasive animals are removed, restoring wildlife
item.description: The ecosystem of Nu'utele Island is flourishing thanks to successful conservation strategies that eliminated invasive species. This revitalization has enabled native flora to rebound, supporting local farmers in sustainable crop cultivation. The eradication of predatory species has also facilitated the revival of native birds, while sea turtles have finally returned to lay their eggs on the island’s shores after years of absence.
